ActorView.description: The person behind an action on a review, as the page names them.

github_user_id.description: Stable GitHub identity. The login below is display metadata.

login.description: The login they were known by when they acted. Display metadata.

profile_url.description: Their profile on the deployment's GitHub host.

attempt.description:
This session's place among the finding series' sessions at this
 commit, at most 3.

cause.description: Why Proofline ended or refused the session, as a closed code.

connection_id.description: The vendor connection the session was started with.

done.description: Whether Proofline stopped following the session.

finding_id.description: The finding the session works on.

observed_head_sha.description:
The pull request's head when it had moved past the reviewed commit,
 for a `HEAD_MOVED` session.

pull_request_url.description:
The pull request the vendor opened, once GitHub confirmed it belongs
 to the target repository.

requested_by_user_id.description: The person who started the session.

review_id.description: The review that recorded the finding.

status.description:
`REQUESTED` until the workflow records a status, then `STARTING`,
 `RUNNING`, `FINISHED`, `FAILED`, `REFUSED`, `HEAD_MOVED` or
 `UNKNOWN`.

target.description: The pull request and commit the session is pinned to.

untrusted_vendor_summary.description: The vendor's summary: untrusted text, never acted on.

updated_at.description: When the session's latest status was recorded.

vendor.description: The coding-agent vendor running the session.

vendor_url.description: The session in the vendor's console.

prompt_digest.description:
SHA-256 of `untrusted_text`. A start names it, so the session
 sends what the person confirmed.

target.description: The pull request and commit a session would be pinned to.

untrusted_text.description:
The exact text a vendor receives: untrusted finding data with
 every protected value withheld.

withheld_values.description: How many protected values were withheld from the prompt.

reason.description: Why this finding cannot start a session.

AgentSessionTarget.description: What a session is pinned to: the finding's own reviewed pull request.

github_repository_id.description: The repository's stable GitHub ID, which the connection allowlists.

head_sha.description: The exact commit the review read. The session starts from it.

repository_full_name.description: The repository's `owner/name` on GitHub, as last recorded.

assessment_id.description: Assessment whose approval could not supply deferred occurrence questions.

code.description: Reason the assessment's approval could not supply deferred occurrence questions.

assessment_id.description: Assessment that owns this route binding.

pass_output_recorded.description: Whether this assessment retained a generalist output record.

pass_output_sha256.description: Digest of the immutable generalist output, when the assessment retained one.

passes.description: Pass and symbolic model binding retained by the plan.

reach.description: Environment reach retained by the plan.

AttributedChange.description: How one condition relates to the review's base revision.

oneOf.description: The proposed revision holds the condition and the base did not.
The site held a different condition at the base.

The base already held this condition at this site. Pre-existing,
 not safe.
The base held this condition and the proposed revision no longer does.

World could not match the condition with its predecessor, such as a
 declaration that may have moved; its origin is unknown.

change.description: How this condition relates to the review's base revision.

reviewed_tree_citations.description: The member that declares the site at each revision that declares it.

revision.description:
The revision that holds the condition: the base for `RESOLVED`, the
 proposed revision for `INTRODUCED`, `CHANGED` and `UNCHANGED`, and
 either for `UNATTRIBUTED`.

subject.description:
World's label of the condition's site and what it declares, such as
 `.github/workflows/ci.yml jobs.test.steps[0].uses: actions/checkout@v4`.
 It quotes repository text.

oneOf.description: The reviewed commit.
Its merge base.
World read the complete set of conditions at both revisions.

World could not read one revision's conditions, so no condition is
 called new or old.

The receipt carries an attribution this build cannot read. No
 condition is called new or old.

id.description:
The pull request author's GitHub user ID, the value the `author` filter
 accepts.

login.description:
The author's most recently recorded GitHub login, a display label. Null
 when none is recorded.

oneOf.description:
The record is verified but too large for this projection to carry.
 Siblings still render; nothing is inferred from the omitted detail.
Still waiting for an authorized execution or a decidable look.
World recorded every deferred question.
At least one deferred question is not bound to the execution.
The gate never authorized the execution.

The capture failed before it wrote its receipt. The gate is
 unchanged; nothing is inferred about the deferred questions.

ChangeAttributionView.description:
Which conditions behind a check's result the change brought, and which
 World found at the review's base revision. It sits beside the result and
 never changes it: a condition already at the base is still a condition.

complete_record.description:
Where every condition is recorded when some are omitted. Absent when
 `conditions` lists them all.

condition_count.description:
How many conditions World attributed, listed or not. Zero unless
 `status` is `COMPARED`.

conditions.description:
Every condition, each once, in World's order, never netted against
 another. Empty unless `status` is `COMPARED`, and empty when some are
 omitted: it never lists only some of them.

counts.description:
How many conditions there are of each change at each revision, over
 every condition, listed or not. Changes with none are left out.

detail_code.description:
World's code for why it could not read that revision, such as
 `BASE_REVIEWED_TREE_NOT_DECLARED`. Present exactly when `status` is
 `UNAVAILABLE`.

listed_conditions.description:
The conditions a summary lists when some are omitted: the first ones
 in the order `counts` gives, each whole, at most 50 and always fewer
 than `condition_count`. Present exactly when `omitted_condition_count`
 is not zero.

omitted_condition_count.description:
How many of those conditions this response does not list. Zero when
 the result kept World's attribution whole. Otherwise the result kept a
 summary: `listed_conditions` lists the first ones, `counts` is still
 exact, and World's recorded evaluation holds every condition.

revision.description:
The revision World could not read. Present exactly when `status` is
 `UNAVAILABLE`.

status.description:
Whether World compared both revisions, could not read one, or recorded
 an attribution this build cannot read.

ChangeCountView.description: How many conditions are of one change at one revision.

change.description: How the counted conditions relate to the review's base revision.

count.description:
How many conditions have this `change` at this `revision`, over every
 condition, listed or not.

revision.description: The revision that holds the counted conditions.

oneOf.description: No interaction between three or more components survived selection.
The head's code index could not vouch for every edge.
The changed call path is larger than a diagram shows.
A decision the diagram depends on gave no answer.

ChangeDiagramView.description: The change-level diagram recorded for a review, or why there is none.

kind.description: Diagram format when a diagram was drawn; otherwise null.

legend.description:
Markdown lines under the diagram: which environment and snapshot its
 dashed relations come from, or which environment was not read.

mermaid.description:
Mermaid source the server generated from the stored graph. Every
 label is escaped, and no model wrote any of it. Absent unless
 `outcome` is `DRAWN`.

outcome.description: Whether the diagram was drawn, or why no diagram is available.

ChangeSummary.description: What a review recorded about its change.

base_sha.description: The compared base commit. Null when the review pinned none.

files.description:
The changed files the review read, by path, with the depth it read
 them at. Empty when the review recorded no change digest. Files the
 review's filters kept from review are listed apart, with their reason.

prose.description:
Model-written prose. Present only when `prose_outcome` is `PUBLISHED`.
 It is untrusted text: render it inert.

prose_outcome.description: The recorded prose-generation outcome, before response-time withholding.

route.description:
The route the summary applied. Null when the review recorded no change
 digest, so no route was asked.

CheckLifecycle.description:
World's lifecycle disclosure for the evaluator version that answered, as
 the receipt recorded it. A deployment gate counts only `GATING` results
 (`DeterministicCoverage::gate_effective_status`), and only when it
 evaluates a deployment; the lifecycle alone permits or blocks nothing.

oneOf.description:
Eligible to count toward a deployment gate. A receipt recorded before
 lifecycle disclosure reads as this, the meaning its decisions were
 made under.
Recorded for review. A gate never counts it.

Suspended after a recorded outcome contradicted it. A gate never
 counts it.
Withdrawn. It takes part in no new evaluation.
The receipt carries a disclosure this projection cannot read.

CodeAssessmentStatus.description:
A code assessment's recorded execution status. It is never a verdict on
 the change: only `COMPLETED` says the assessment covered what it read.

oneOf.description:
The repository's review configuration excluded the change, so the
 code assessment read nothing.

CommentAddressEvaluationView.description: One stored post-merge judgment of a finding comment.

outcome.description: `ADDRESSED`, `NOT_ADDRESSED`, or `INCOMPLETE` when the merged code could not be judged.

CommentReactionView.description: One stored reaction on the finding's root comment.

actor_github_user_id.description: The stable GitHub identity of whoever reacted.

github_comment_id.description: The GitHub comment the reaction is on: the finding's root comment.

reaction.description: The reaction as GitHub names it.

CommitReviewRequest.description:
Pushed commits to review: the exact base the change is compared with and
 the exact head it ends at.

base_commit_sha.description:
The full 40-character commit the change is compared with. GitHub must
 have it in this repository, and it must be an ancestor of the head.

head_commit_sha.description:
The full 40-character commit the change ends at. GitHub must have it
 in this repository.

CommitReviewResponse.description: What a commit review request produced.

existing.description:
True when these exact commits already had a review and that one is
 returned. Sending the same commits twice reviews them once.

review_id.description:
The review of these commits, readable through the review and findings
 routes.

CompleteRecordView.description:
World's immutable record of the complete answer an omitted list comes
 from.

attribution_digest.description: The `sha256:` digest of the complete attribution in that record.

world_evaluation_id.description: The evaluation World recorded, which holds every condition.

checks.description: The deterministic World checks recorded for this assessment.

completed_at.description: When the assessment completed. Null while it has not.

decision_presentation.description:
The retained decision disclosure, which grants no deployment
 authorization. Absent when none is recorded and the review kind
 records no decision basis.

declared_reach.description:
What World declares depends on what this change deploys in this
 environment, at the assessment's pinned snapshot. Absent when the
 assessment's kind records no declared reach.

domains.description:
The risk domains the assessment evaluated, each with its status and
 reason, ordered by domain.

environment_display_name.description: The display name of the environment this assessment covers.

findings.description: The findings this assessment recorded, `SERIOUS` first.

incompleteness_kind.description:
Why an `INCOMPLETE` assessment is incomplete: `NOT_CONFIGURED`,
 `POLICY_EXCLUDED`, `EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE`, `HYPOTHESES_UNRESOLVED` or
 `MODEL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`. Absent otherwise; an unclassified gap is not a
 complete assessment.

reason_codes.description:
Public assessment gap codes. A recorded out-of-credits refusal
 is projected as `OUT_OF_CREDITS` when no stored code exists. Other
 historical records may have no codes; private details are not exposed.

release_evidence_gap.description:
The typed gap the automatic release-set read recorded. Null when the
 read is pending, pinned a release, or was never attempted.

started_at.description: When the assessment started. Null until it starts.

status.description:
The assessment's recorded status, such as `RUNNING`, `COMPLETED` or
 `INCOMPLETE`.

checks.description: The deterministic World checks recorded for this assessment.

completed_at.description: When the assessment completed. Null while it has not.

decision_presentation.description:
The retained decision disclosure, which grants no deployment
 authorization. Absent when none is recorded and the review kind
 records no decision basis.

declared_reach.description:
What World declares depends on what this change deploys in this
 environment, at the assessment's pinned snapshot. Absent when the
 assessment's kind records no declared reach.

domains.description:
The risk domains the assessment evaluated, each with its status and
 reason, ordered by domain.

environment_display_name.description: The display name of the environment this assessment covers.

findings.description: The findings this assessment recorded, `SERIOUS` first.

incompleteness_kind.description:
Why an `INCOMPLETE` assessment is incomplete: `NOT_CONFIGURED`,
 `POLICY_EXCLUDED`, `EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE`, `HYPOTHESES_UNRESOLVED` or
 `MODEL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`. Absent otherwise; an unclassified gap is not a
 complete assessment.

reason_codes.description:
Public assessment gap codes. A recorded out-of-credits refusal
 is projected as `OUT_OF_CREDITS` when no stored code exists. Other
 historical records may have no codes; private details are not exposed.

release_evidence_gap.description:
The typed gap the automatic release-set read recorded. Null when the
 read is pending, pinned a release, or was never attempted.

review_id.description: The review this assessment belongs to.

started_at.description: When the assessment started. Null until it starts.

status.description:
The assessment's recorded status, such as `RUNNING`, `COMPLETED` or
 `INCOMPLETE`.

subjects.description:
The review subjects this assessment's own release set authorized, plus
 each `PRIMARY` subject that carries no release authorization.

change_attribution.description:
Which conditions behind the outcome the change brought and which were
 already at the review's base revision. It never changes the outcome:
 a condition already at the base is pre-existing, not safe. Absent for
 a check whose evaluator does not compare the two revisions.

detail.description:
Why World refused the check, or otherwise World's recorded explanation
 of the result. Null when neither is recorded.

evaluated_at.description:
When World evaluated this answer. A reused answer is evidence from
 this instant, which can precede the assessment.

lifecycle.description:
The lifecycle of the evaluator version that answered. It says whether
 a deployment gate could count this result, not whether one did.

name.description: The check's readable name, derived from its key.

outcome.description:
The outcome the receipt recorded, which is the outcome a deployment
 gate weighed: `READY`, `BLOCKED`, `UNRESOLVED`, `UNAVAILABLE`,
 `NOT_APPLICABLE` or `NOT_ASKED`. A verdict never rewrites it.

unresolved_reason.description:
Why an `UNRESOLVED` check did not settle, as World's verdict gave it.
 Absent on every other outcome, and on an unresolved receipt whose
 verdict names none of these reasons.

families.description:
One entry per recorded check result, ordered by check key and version.
 Empty when no receipt exists.

receipt_recorded.description:
Whether these checks come from an immutable deterministic coverage
 receipt. When false, no check result is recorded.

status.description:
The receipt's status, or `PENDING`, `SUPERSEDED`, `STOPPED`,
 `NOT_ATTEMPTED` or `UNAVAILABLE` when no receipt exists.

CustomerCodeAssessment.description:
The review's code assessment as it recorded its run. Its findings
 rest on the pinned code alone, never on World evidence.

base_commit_sha.description: The base commit the code assessment compared the head with.

completed_at.description: When the code assessment ended. Null while it has not.

findings.description:
The code-only findings the code assessment recorded, `SERIOUS` first.
 An empty list does not establish deployment safety.

head_commit_sha.description: The head commit the code assessment read.

incompleteness_kind.description:
Why an `INCOMPLETE` code assessment is incomplete: `NOT_CONFIGURED`,
 `POLICY_EXCLUDED`, `EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE`, `HYPOTHESES_UNRESOLVED` or
 `MODEL_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`. Null otherwise.

started_at.description: When the code assessment started. Null until it starts.

status.description: The code assessment's recorded execution status.

authority.description: Whether the decision is `ADVISORY` or comes from a `DEPLOYMENT_POLICY`.

availability.description:
Whether a verified decision record is present, absent, legacy, failed,
 or too large for this projection.

basis.description:
The permission, evidence classification and reason code of the
 verified recorded basis. Null when no verified basis is recorded.

gate_state.description:
The local deployment gate state and any recorded override. Null unless
 the decision belongs to a deployment gate.

evidence.description: How the recorded basis classified its evidence.

permission.description: The permission the recorded basis reached: `PERMIT` or `BLOCK`.

reason_code.description: The reason code the recorded basis gives for its permission.

commit_sha.description:
The commit a file or commit reference reads. Null for other kinds, and
 for a file reference whose review recorded no head commit.

companion_repository.description:
The repository a `companion_repository_file` reference reads from.
 Null for every other kind.

end_line.description:
The last cited line of a file reference. Null when the reference names
 no end line or is not a file reference.

file_sha256.description:
SHA256 of the complete original file bytes retained by a trusted ENV
 or CODE read. Absent on older references and partial reads.

label.description:
The reference's display label, such as a path with its line range. A
 recorded read, a vendor documentation read or an unnamed World entity
 carries a fixed label, and a deterministic test carries its check's
 readable name.

legacy_text.description:
The unstructured text of a `text` reference. Null for structured
 references and for recorded reads.

provenance_status.description:
How the reference was obtained: `VERIFIED_REPOSITORY_READ`,
 `PINNED_WORLD_ENTITY`, `EXECUTED_DETERMINISTIC_TEST`,
 `EXECUTED_SANDBOX_EXPERIMENT`, `PROVIDER_REFERENCE`, `RECORDED_READ`
 or `LEGACY_UNSTRUCTURED`.

repository_path.description: The cited file's path for a file reference. Null for every other kind.

start_line.description:
The first cited line of a file reference. Null when the reference cites
 no line or is not a file reference.

url.description:
The link the reference resolves to. Null when it resolves to none or
 the review's repository or head commit is unknown.

workflow_attempt.description:
The run attempt of a `workflow_run` reference. Null when the reference
 names no attempt or is another kind.

workflow_run_id.description:
The GitHub Actions run ID of a `workflow_run` reference. Null for every
 other kind.

causal_graph.description:
The typed causal graph the reviewer supplied for an ordering or
 reachability finding. Null when the finding carries none.

claim.description: What the reviewer states is wrong.

comment_evaluation.description:
The post-merge judgment of whether the finding comment was addressed.
 It is not a finding decision; null when none is recorded.

comment_reactions.description:
Emoji reactions stored on the Proofline finding comment. They are not a
 finding decision.

evidence_class.description:
The kind of proof the finding rests on, derived from the typed evidence
 it cites. Null on findings recorded before the class existed.

evidence_refs.description:
The references the finding cites, resolved as the pull request comment
 resolves them.

finding_fingerprint.description:
The retained semantic fingerprint used to correlate findings. It is
 opaque and separate from the occurrence ID and reviewed code digest.
 Absent when no fingerprint is retained; no replacement is derived.

github_comment_url.description:
The inline GitHub comment published for this occurrence of the finding.
 Null when none was published; earlier runs are never used as a fallback.

impact.description: The consequence the reviewer states the claim has.

latest_validation.description:
The latest decision on the finding's series, with who made it, where
 and when. Null when no decision is recorded.

lifecycle_state.description:
The finding's recorded lifecycle state: `NEW`, `UNCHANGED`, `RESOLVED`
 or `REINTRODUCED`.

placement.description:
Where this review's comment gate placed the finding, as it recorded
 the placement. Null when the review recorded none.

remediation.description: The reviewer's proposed fix. Null when it proposed none.

risk_domain.description: The risk domain the reviewer assigned to the finding.

rule_refs.description:
The bound review rules the reviewer cited for this finding, by key and
 the revisions its assessment showed the reviewer. A finding carried
 forward unchanged keeps the citations of the finding it carries. Empty
 when it cited none.

supporting_evidence.description:
The verdict explanation and evidence of the supported hypothesis that
 produced this finding. Null when the finding links no supported
 hypothesis.

symbols.description:
The code identifiers the reviewer declared in the finding's prose, in
 declaration order, so a reader can set each as code.

thread_observation.description:
The latest observation of the finding's GitHub thread state. It is not
 a finding decision; null when none is recorded.

validation.description:
The latest decision on the finding, the same value `latest_validation`
 carries. Null when no decision is recorded.

actor_github_user_id.description: The actor's stable GitHub user ID. Null for the automatic decision.

actor_login.description:
The actor's GitHub login, a display label to render as text. Null for
 the automatic decision.

covering_author_kind.description: For `ALREADY_COVERED`, `HUMAN` or `BOT`. Null for every other decision.

covering_author_login.description:
For `ALREADY_COVERED`, the login of whoever wrote the covering comment,
 to render as text. Null for every other decision.

covering_comment_created_at.description:
For `ALREADY_COVERED`, when the covering comment was written. Null for
 every other decision.

github_comment_url.description:
The comment that carried a decision made on GitHub, or, for
 `ALREADY_COVERED`, the other reviewer's comment the decision rests on.

source.description:
Where the decision came from: `UI` for the app's assessment controls,
 `GITHUB_COMMENT` for a pull request comment, or `PROOFLINE` for the
 automatic `ALREADY_COVERED` decision.

actions.description: Which review actions the caller may take now.

assessment_count.description: How many environment assessments this review has.

assessments.description: The environment assessments this review recorded.

base_branch_commit_sha.description:
The base branch tip GitHub reported when the review was triggered,
 display metadata that differs from `base_commit_sha` when the base
 branch moved after the branch point.

base_commit_sha.description:
The base revision the review compares against; for a pull request, the
 merge base of its head and base branch. Null until pinned, and for a
 first deployment.

base_commit_url.description:
The GitHub page for `base_commit_sha`. Null when that commit or the
 repository is unknown.

base_ref.description:
The pull request's base branch name as last recorded from GitHub, for
 orientation only. Null when no pull request state is recorded.

change_diagram.description:
The change-level diagram: the changed call path from the pinned code
 index and the relations World declares. Absent when the review
 recorded none.

change_summary.description:
What the change does and which files the review read at which depth
 (§55). Null until the review's publication records it, and for a
 review that is not of a pull request. Generated text has current
 credentials and recorded protected values withheld; missing or expired
 provenance withholds the generated text whole.

check_run_url.description:
The GitHub check run Proofline published for this review. Null when
 none was published.

code_assessment.description:
The code assessment this review recorded, apart from its environment
 assessments. Null when the review recorded none. It never completes an
 environment assessment, and no environment count includes its findings.

compare_url.description:
The GitHub comparison of the base and head commits. Null unless both
 are pinned and the repository is known, and for a patch review, whose
 head GitHub does not have.

completed_at.description: When the review reached a terminal status. Absent while it is still pending or running.

current_head_commit_sha.description: The pull request's head commit as the latest provider projection reports it, which can differ from `head_commit_sha`. Set only on a single-review read, and absent for a deployment review or a pull request with no projection.

deep_review_escalation.description:
Automatic Deep Review outcome for this exact pinned comparison. Absent
 when no sensitive-path evaluation receipt was recorded.

diff_stats.description:
Line totals from this run's pinned comparison. Null until recorded, or
 when the provider's changed-file list was incomplete.

environment_display_names.description: Display names of this review's assessed environments, not current repository links.

finding_count.description: How many findings this review's assessments recorded, across all of them.

head_commit_sha.description:
The head commit this review is pinned to. For a patch review, the
 revision ID Proofline derives from its base commit and patch digest,
 which is not a commit. Absent when the review recorded none.

head_commit_url.description:
The exact revision reviewed. A commit URL, never a branch URL: the
 branch moves, the reviewed input does not. Absent for a patch review.

head_ref.description:
The pull request's head branch name as last recorded from GitHub, for
 orientation only. Null when no pull request state is recorded.

is_deep_review.description: Present and true when this run is a Deep Review.

kind.description:
`PULL_REQUEST`, `DEPLOYMENT`, `PATCH`, a review of local changes
 sent as a patch, `COMMIT`, a review of pushed commits, or `FILES`,
 complete selected files at one pushed commit.

local_reverifications.description:
For a patch review requested with `verify_finding_ids`, each finding
 it re-verifies against the patch and the outcome. The outcome is
 local: the pull request's finding is unchanged whatever it is. Absent
 otherwise.

merge_gate.description:
The deterministic policy for this exact repository/head, when opted in.
 Its captured review owner and GitHub bypass remain separate history.

open_items.description:
What Proofline still has open for the reviewed head, counted from the
 current finding decisions. Absent while the review is `PENDING` or
 `RUNNING`.

open_items_observation.description:
Dated PR counts with head, evaluated-scope and bounded thread proof.
 Absent when that observation is unavailable; scalar counts remain separate.

public_key.description: The review's stable public address: `rev_` followed by its identifier without hyphens.

publication.description:
Whether the review reached the pull request: `PUBLISHED`, `WITHHELD`,
 `PUBLICATION_REQUESTED` or `PUBLICATION_REFUSED`. A review run from
 Proofline is withheld until somebody publishes it.

publication_detail.description: Why a publication was refused, or how one failed. Server text.

pull_request_author_avatar_url.description:
Provider-supplied avatar URL. Login-derived `.png` URLs do not work for
 GitHub App bot accounts and are not portable across GitHub hosts.

pull_request_author_github_user_id.description:
The author's stable GitHub user id: identity for profile lookups,
 never display text. Absent when GitHub named no author.

pull_request_author_login.description: Provider display metadata for the pull request author, not the rerun requester.

pull_request_author_url.description: The author's profile on the deployment's GitHub host. Absent when no author login is known.

pull_request_number.description: The pull request number. Absent for a deployment or patch review.

pull_request_state.description:
Current provider state of the pull request: `OPEN`, `CLOSED`, or
 `MERGED`. Absent for deployment reviews or a missing projection.

pull_request_title.description:
The pull request's title as provider state last reported it, so it
 names the change rather than only numbering it. Untrusted text:
 renderers must treat it as text, never markup.

pull_request_url.description: The pull request on GitHub. Absent for a deployment review or when the repository is unknown.

refresh.description:
How this review decided what it reviews after a push or a full-review
 request. Absent for a review that refreshes nothing, and while a
 refresh has not decided yet.

related_reviews.description:
Every other run for this pull request the caller can see, plus reviews
 joined to this one by supersession or rerun.

repository_full_name.description: The repository's `owner/name`. Absent when the review names no repository.

repository_id.description: The review's repository. Set only on a single-review read, and absent there when the review names no repository.

repository_name.description: The repository's name within its owner. Absent when the review names no repository.

repository_url.description:
The repository on GitHub. Absent when the deployment's web base
 cannot be joined with the stored name.

requested_by.description:
Who asked for this review, for a review a person requested. Null on
 automatic reviews and on reviews recorded before requesters were.

review_comment_url.description:
The pull request review Proofline submitted for this review. Null when
 it submitted none.

review_retracted_at.description:
When a submitted pull request review was marked retracted, a marker
 only older versions set. Null otherwise.

run_number.description: One-based, append-only ordinal within one repository pull request.

status.description: The review's lifecycle status: `PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `COMPLETED`, `INCOMPLETE`, `FAILED`, `SUPERSEDED`, `STOPPED` or `EXCLUDED`.

stoppable.description:
Whether the stop action applies: the review is `PENDING` or `RUNNING`
 and decides no deployment gate. It says nothing about the caller's
 permission.

stopped_at.description: When the review was stopped. Null unless it was stopped.

stopped_by.description:
Who stopped this review, for a `STOPPED` review whose stop recorded its
 actor. Null otherwise.

stopped_from.description:

 the stop recorded it.
